case_scope: Netherlands national wealth order with housing-tenure and family-entry pressure

bottom_50_private_wealth_share.note: CBS wealth statistics keep the Netherlands case blocked on private wealth concentration even where incomes and social protections are stronger.

middle_40_private_wealth_share.note: Middle wealth is intertwined with housing tenure and pension treatment; owner/renter split is decisive.

next_9_private_wealth_share.note: Needs direct extraction from CBS/OECD/WID-compatible data.

top_1_private_wealth_share.note: Top-tail concentration and owner/renter differences require direct extraction from CBS distributional wealth tables before comfort scoring.

top_0_1_private_wealth_share.note: Controller-level data needed for top-tail and dynasty screen.

public_social_counterweight.note: Social, pension, and public-service counterweights matter, but they do not erase housing-market and asset-ownership gaps.

lower_half_real_floor.note: The social floor is materially stronger, but lower-half liquidity, claimability, and renter asset-building need testing.

early_foothold_open_access.note: Parental wealth and homeownership position appear increasingly important for children’s wealth rank and housing path.

parent_backed_threshold_dependency.note: Needs direct measures of deposits, guarantees, co-residence, and parental transfers before open-circulation comfort.

group_person_closure.note: Migrant, gender, household-type, and person-level title/control surfaces are not yet extracted.

housing_land_washout.note: Owner-occupier and renter divides, housing shortage, mortgage/wealth tax interactions, and constrained access can wash out income-equality gains.

debt_fee_washout.note: Needs debt-quality and renter/owner fragility data.

wealth_to_rule_risk.note: Top-tail and real-estate transparency need monitoring but are not the opening breach.

ownership_legibility.note: CBS tables improve legibility but household-level ownership, business wealth, pension wealth, and intergenerational transfers need aligned extraction.

climate_insurance_drag.note: not yet measured in this active bounded case; hazard-exposed local housing markets should be tested separately.

digital_intangible_concentration.note: Relevant to high-productivity frontier firms but not the dominant current breach.

dynastic_infrastructure_pressure.note: Parental wealth persistence and inheritance timing keep dynasty watch active.

monetary_asset_price_channel.note: House-price and mortgage-market dynamics can convert macro-financial conditions into incumbent advantage.

case_notes: Near-miss case: strong social floor does not settle the private entry question.
